messages:
Lena (AE): Heads-up: MeridianCare needs executive signoff fast. They want a dedicated pool in 10 days, KMS import, and a 90-day egress waiver for their POC. They said they'll sign today if we can commit.
Diego (SE): Quick note: KMS import implies Private deployment. For Dedicated we can do BYOK via cloud KMS but not import raw HSM keys. Need their peak qps and avg tokens to size.
Ravi (Eng): Ops can reassign capacity to hit 10 days with emergency approval. Default provisioning is ~3 weeks. We need a PO before reallocation.
Nora (Security): We'll provide SOC2 link and redacted pen-test summary. HSM attestation isn't possible on short notice. Legal will need to see concession wording for egress waiver.
Lena (AE): Clara - are concessions allowed here?
Clara (VP Sales): For strategic deals we can do up to 12% ACV discount and a 90-day egress waiver if Finance signs off. Need SE to confirm mitigations.
Diego (SE): Mitigation suggestions: enable prefix/KV caching, recommend a quantized model, and reserve a small burst pool. Expect ~25% infra reduction. Need qps/tokens.
Lena (AE): Customer replied: peak 75 qps, avg 220 tokens.
Ravi (Eng): With 75 qps and 220 tokens, estimate 4 GPUs for p99 < 300ms. Emergency allocation -> ~9-10 days. Ops risk: could impact internal dev queues.
Legal (Counsel): Drafted SOW concession: "90-day egress waiver for POC environment only; standard egress pricing resumes after waiver unless amended." Posting it here.
FinanceBot: Finance requires signed concession in SOW and PO email before processing. Expedited review possible (~4 hours) if marked urgent.
Lena (AE): I sent PO + SOW draft to finance (cc Clara).
FinanceBot: Received. Finance started expedited review.
Ravi (Eng): Once Finance confirms, I'll open ops ticket and start reallocation.
Diego (SE): I'll prepare one-pager with sizing and fallback plan and upload it here.
Nora (Security): Added checklist items: SOC2 link, network diagram, minimal retention policy.
Lena (AE): Customer: "We'll sign now if Redwood confirms the 10-day ETA and 90-day waiver." PO attached.
FinanceBot: Approved the concession and PO. Revenue ops processed order.
Clara (VP Sales): Greenlight given. Ravi, proceed with emergency allocation. Keep exec updated.
Ravi (Eng): Ops ticket #40988 created. ETA 9 days. Runbook uploaded to ops portal.
Diego (SE): Canary tests scheduled post-provision; will validate perf before cutover.
Lena (AE): Closing loop: PO signed, concession approved, ops provisioning started. Posting exec summary to leadership after initial provisioning begins.
Clara (VP Sales): Thanks team, great coordination.
